I’m a sophomore at Pomona College studying Mathematics on the Statistics track, with a minor in Data Science. Through my coursework, I’ve become fascinated by how statistics and data science can be used to uncover patterns, make predictions, and understand risk. These interests have drawn me towards a career in statistics, where I hope to apply my mathematical and analytical skills to real-world problems.

This site is where I share the projects, research, and experiences that are shaping my growth as a statistician and data scientist, along with the questions I’m exploring along the way.

**Hobbies:** Painting, Reading, Baseball (Go Dodgers!), Coffee, and Spending ime with my family.
